title: Figure 2.3: Photograph of a STAR Mode Discharge in a Vane-Type IEC Grid
description: Color photograph of a spherical 'vane' type IEC grid glowing with a purple-white plasma, with bright star-like rays radiating through the grid openings from the center. The caption describes it as one of several large-opening grids designed for STAR mode operation of the neutron source type IEC, used by UIUC, Daimler-Chrysler and Kyoto University, made of materials from stainless steel to Mo.
